_comment_voice_enabled: If false, Nova skips loading Vosk/the microphone entirely and instead takes typed commands in the transcript window. Set to true once you're ready to test wake-word listening again.
_comment_tts_enabled: If false, Nova stays silent and just prints/logs replies instead of speaking them aloud. Set to true to hear Nova talk again.
_comment_use_ai_brain: If true (default) and the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable is set, commands go to Claude Haiku 4.5 for interpretation before falling back to offline pattern matching. Set to false to force offline-only mode even with a key set.
_comment_apps: Add any app you want Nova to be allowed to open. key = the word you'll say, value = full path to the .exe (or just the exe name if it's on PATH, like notepad.exe)
_comment_folders: Add any folder you want Nova to be allowed to open in File Explorer.
